query: INSERT INTO Battle_Stats(uid, chat_id, battles_total, battles_won, win_streak_current, lose_streak_current, lost_length) VALUES ($1, $2, 1, 0, 0, 1, $3) ON CONFLICT (uid, chat_id) DO UPDATE SET battles_total = Battle_Stats.battles_total + 1, win_streak_current = 0, lose_streak_current = Battle_Stats.lose_streak_current + 1, lost_length = Battle_Stats.lost_length + $3 RETURNING battles_total, battles_won, lose_streak_current
